q: How much does construction site security cost in Oldham and Greater Manchester?
a: The cost depends on the number of officers, the hours covered and the level of risk on your site. A single gate officer for working hours is a very different job to 24/7 cover with patrols, so we do not quote a one-size-fits-all rate. Call us on 07585690268 and we will give you a clear written quote for your site, with no obligation.

q: Do I need security on a building site overnight?
a: There is no general legal requirement, but many insurers and main contractors expect it, especially where copper, plant, tools or materials are stored on site. Most construction thefts happen out of hours, so overnight and weekend cover is where security makes the biggest difference. If a full-time officer is more than you need, scheduled lock-up and mobile patrols are a lower-cost option.

q: Can you cover a construction site at short notice?
a: Yes. We can usually have an officer on site within one to two hours of your call, subject to availability. Being based in Chadderton, Oldham means we can reach sites across Oldham and the surrounding towns quickly if you have a break-in, a no-show from another provider or a sudden change in risk.

q: Are your construction site security officers SIA licensed?
a: Yes. Every officer holds the SIA licence required for the role they are working, and MD Security Services carries public liability insurance.
